_comment: WebView2 Fixed Version 109 is the last runtime that still launches on Windows 8.1.
Evergreen WebView2 (what the Windows 10/11 installer embeds) refuses to install there.
The cabinet is the official Microsoft Fixed Version package, archived at the URL below
because Microsoft only keeps a short sliding window of Fixed Version downloads.
The size is the GitHub release-asset size for this exact filename; a mismatch means the
archive was replaced and the build must stop rather than pack an unverified runtime.
After extraction, package-windows81.ps1 also requires msedgewebview2.exe to be
Authenticode-signed by Microsoft before it is copied into the 8.1 installer or portable.
